title: 第19章 给自己一个锚点第20章 老前辈的刷新点
content_zh:
;;
大锅里咕嘟咕嘟炖着喷香的羊肉，苏白尘在旁边看着火候……
说起来，这里原本应该是摆放炼丹炉的吧？没想到丹炉换成了大锅。
他大概明白了玄阴真人的一个小秘密……或者说是小癖好，那就是口腹之欲！
他看着那羊肉汤炖的火候已经差不多了，就连忙叫来玄阴真人：“师父，已经可以吃了。”
玄阴真人慢悠悠地晃荡过来，接过了汤碗品尝了一口，感慨道：“不错，没什么腥膻味，到底是农人家的孩子早当家……手艺不错。”
苏白尘就觉得颇为违和，他还以为长春宫的修士都吃得清淡。
“白尘，你也来吃点吧。”
苏白尘端着个碗有些犹豫，他问：“师父，这样会不会坏了修行？”
玄阴真人嗤笑：“我当是什么事，原来你是在担心这个。”
“你首先得知道，修者为何要克制餐饮又为什么要有禁欲的做法？”
苏白尘理所当然地答：“若是放纵欲望，会扰乱心思，让神思难以集中于修行……胡思乱想之下，甚至会被心魔所趁。”
玄阴真人不置可否地说：“很标准的答案。”
“但对我们阴宗不适用。”
苏白尘感到疑惑。
“我阴宗借助玄阴灵气修炼，阴气炼入骨脉，那霜寒之意甚至可以冻结心智！”
“它固然会令我等变得更为理智、清醒，却也同样会让我们变得更冷漠、无情。若是不加遏制地陷于这等冷漠、无情之中，那修者迟早会彻底失去为人之心，从而变成将万物视作刍狗的无情者。”
说到这里，玄阴真人慢条斯理地夹起一块羊肉咬了一口，同时说：“你也吃啊。”
苏白尘连忙自己也吃了起来，他大概有些明白玄阴真人的意思了。
“师父，你的意思是说，要培养一个无伤大雅的兴趣，成为我们继续作为人的锚点？”

玄阴真人咽下羊肉捋了捋胡子：“说得没错，这就是我要说的。”
“别人修行生怕自己欲望太多念头太杂，可是我们阴宗修士却就怕自己没有任何想做的事情。”
“否则这么继续修行下去，人和一根木头有什么区别？”
“我辈修者踏上修行之路，哪有初衷是当一块木头的？”
说到这里，玄阴真人拍了拍苏白尘的肩膀继续道：“若是有朝一日你忽然觉得做什么都无趣了，那就好好回想一下自己踏入这条修行道路最初的渴望是什么。”
“不要放任这种无趣持续下去，你要想尽办法寻回那份渴望。”
苏白尘认真地点点头：“我知道了师父，弟子一定谨记师父的教导，活得有滋有味。”
这么一说，他可就想法多起来了啊。
这一顿羊肉汤也可以说是他自重生以来吃得最好的一顿了，毕竟他此前根本没有机会弄到这么多香料……
倒是没想到，阴宗的外事处有不少好东西……听说都是当药材进的来着？
玄阴真人喝着汤吃着肉，忽然冷不丁地问了一句：“白尘，你觉得我该怎么处理无念子才好呢？”
苏白尘一愣，这怎么问他了？
“我也……”
他准备装傻。
可是玄阴真人说：“只管说说你的想法好了，毕竟虽然没有切实证据，但我们都知道那是一个隐患。”
他看起来是真的对此很头疼。
苏白尘站在玄阴真人的角度想了一下，发现这的确是个很难处理的问题。
还是因为没有切实依据。
而苏白尘猜测，以玄阴真人的行事风格，是绝对不会为了落实那什么‘依据’而去刻意设计自己的徒弟。
不过就算知道这些，他还是要问问清楚：“师父，四师兄可靠吗？”

玄阴真人笑道：“你们所有人都一样，都是自小就在为师身边的。”

The fragrant mutton was simmering in the big pot, and Su Baichen was watching the heat...
Speaking of which, the alchemy furnace should have been placed here, right? Unexpectedly, the alchemy furnace was replaced by a large pot.
He probably understood a little secret of Master Xuanyin...or a little hobby, which was the desire for food and drink!
Seeing that the mutton soup was almost cooked, he quickly called Master Xuanyin: "Master, it's ready to eat."
Master Xuanyin wandered over slowly, took the soup bowl, took a sip, and said with emotion: "It's good, it doesn't have any fishy smell. After all, he is a farmer's child who has long been in charge... his craftsmanship is good."
Su Baichen felt that it was quite inconsistent. He thought that the monks in Changchun Palace had light meals.
"Bai Chen, come and have some too."
Su Baichen hesitated while holding a bowl. He asked, "Master, will this ruin your practice?"
Master Xuanyin sneered: "I didn't think it was anything. It turns out you were worried about this."
"You first need to know why practitioners abstain from eating and drinking and why they practice abstinence?"
Su Baichen answered naturally: "If you indulge your desires, it will disturb your mind and make it difficult to concentrate on practice... You may even be taken advantage of by your inner demons if you have random thoughts."
Master Xuanyin said noncommittally: "A very standard answer."
"But it doesn't apply to our Yin Sect."
Su Baichen was confused.
"My Yin Sect cultivates with the help of Xuanyin spiritual energy. The Yin energy is refined into the bone veins, and the frosty meaning can even freeze the mind!"
"Although it will make us more rational and clear-headed, it will also make us more indifferent and ruthless. If we fall into this kind of indifference and ruthlessness without restraint, sooner or later the practitioner will completely lose his or her heart as a human being and become a ruthless person who regards all things as stupid dogs."
Having said this, Master Xuanyin slowly picked up a piece of mutton and took a bite. At the same time, he said, "You can eat it too."
Su Baichen quickly started eating it himself. He probably understood what Master Xuanyin meant.
"Master, do you mean to cultivate an innocuous interest that can serve as an anchor for us to continue as human beings?"
Master Xuanyin swallowed the mutton and stroked his beard: "That's right, that's what I want to say."
"Others who practice are afraid that they have too many desires and thoughts, but we Yin Sect monks are afraid that we don't have anything we want to do."
"Otherwise if we continue to practice like this, what's the difference between a person and a piece of wood?"
"As cultivators like us, when we embark on the path of spiritual practice, how can we have the original intention of being a piece of wood?"
Having said this, Master Xuanyin patted Su Baichen on the shoulder and continued: "If one day you suddenly feel that nothing you do is boring, then think back to your original desire to embark on this path of cultivation."
"Don't let this boredom continue. You must try your best to find that desire."
Su Baichen nodded seriously: "I understand Master. Disciples must remember Master's teachings and live a meaningful life."
After saying this, he had more ideas.
This mutton soup can be said to be the best meal he has eaten since his rebirth. After all, he had never had the opportunity to get so many spices before...
I didn't expect that the Yin Sect's Foreign Affairs Office has a lot of good things... I heard that they are all used as medicinal materials?
Master Xuanyin was drinking soup and eating meat when he suddenly asked coldly: "Bai Chen, what do you think I should do with Wu Nianzi?"
Su Baichen was stunned, why did he ask him this?
"Me too..."
He was going to play dumb.
But Master Xuanyin said: "Just tell me what you think. After all, although there is no concrete evidence, we all know that it is a hidden danger."
He seemed genuinely troubled by this.
Su Baichen thought about it from the perspective of Master Xuanyin and found that this was indeed a difficult problem to deal with.
Or because there is no solid basis.
And Su Baichen guessed that withMaster Xuanyin's acting style is such that he will never deliberately design his disciples in order to implement that 'basis'.
But even if he knew this, he still had to ask clearly: "Master, is the fourth senior brother reliable?"
Master Xuanyin smiled and said: "All of you are the same. You have been with me since you were a child."
